# Wilderness Escape Rentals

> Wilderness Escape Rentals is two family vacation cabins, Pine Shadows (sleeps 12) and Wilderness Escape Retreat (sleeps 9), next door to each other in the lodgepole pines of Island Park, Idaho, about 30 minutes from the West Entrance of Yellowstone National Park. Both have fast, free Wi-Fi that is good for remote work and video calls. Owners Robyn and Eric Eastin host them, and guests book online on this website. The site also has a free seasonal guide to Island Park and Yellowstone with drive times from the cabins.

Office: 3645 Moose Track Ln, Island Park, ID 83440
Email: info@wildernessescaperentals.com
Booking: online through this website (OwnerRez booking engine): https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/book/

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/): the cabins, where they are, what to do by season, booking
- [Pine Shadows](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/cabins/pine-shadows/): sleeps 12, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths
- [Wilderness Escape Retreat](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/cabins/wilderness-escape-retreat/): sleeps 9, 3 bedrooms, 2 baths
- [Book now](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/book/): both cabins' booking forms and availability
- [Reviews](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/reviews/): 18 five-star guest reviews
- [FAQ](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/faq/): Wi-Fi, kitchen, toiletries, booking both cabins, groceries, Yellowstone
- [Things to do](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/guide/): Yellowstone and Island Park guide with drive times, food, groceries, wildlife, events
- [Map](https://www.wildernessescaperentals.com/map/): interactive map of Yellowstone and Island Park with the cabins marked
